title: A seed bigger than its fruit
odia: ବାର ହାତ କାକୁଡ଼ିର ତେର ହାତ ମଞ୍ଜି
literal_meaning: A cucumber twelve cubits long contains a seed thirteen cubits long.
explanation: The part has become larger than the whole that supposedly contains it. The dictionary explicitly calls this an impossible claim. The absurd measurements make a quick test for an exaggerated story: do its own details fit together? The point is inconsistency, not an accurate description of cucumber growth.
meaning_odia: କାକୁଡ଼ି ବାର ହାତ, ହେଲେ ତା ଭିତର ମଞ୍ଜି ତେର ହାତ—ହିସାବଟି ନିଜେ ନିଜକୁ ଖଣ୍ଡନ କରୁଛି। ଅସମ୍ଭବ କଥାକୁ ବଡ଼ କରି କହିବାର ମଜା ଏହି ଚିତ୍ରରେ ଅଛି। କାହାର କଥାରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଅଂଶ ଆଉ ଗୋଟିଏ ସହ ମେଳ ନଖାଇଲେ, ତାହାକୁ ଏହିପରି ହସି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରାଯାଇପାରେ।
english_summary: The part has become larger than the whole that supposedly contains it.
odia_summary: କାକୁଡ଼ି ବାର ହାତ, ହେଲେ ତା ଭିତର ମଞ୍ଜି ତେର ହାତ—ହିସାବଟି ନିଜେ ନିଜକୁ ଖଣ୍ଡନ କରୁଛି।
usage_example: A report claims that one hour-long meeting contained two hours of speeches without any overlap. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Traditional hand-based length language is translated as cubits without a modern centimetre conversion. The source also records a sheath/sword variant, not a separate entry.
